desc: A GPU-accelerated interactive dot matrix background shader with magnetic cursor repulsion, proximity illumination glow, dynamic lens scaling, and ambient wave motion.

name: drag-to-confirm
title: Drag to Confirm
desc: A physical drag-to-confirm slider for high-stakes and destructive actions, equipped with elastic spring snapback physics, progressive track illumination, and accessible keyboard fallbacks.

name: draw-checkbox
title: DrawCheckbox
desc: A checkbox whose checkmark draws itself (path length animation) and settles with a tiny overshoot. The box scales from 0.9 -> 1.04 -> 1.0 for a tactile snap feel.

name: dynamic-island
title: Dynamic Island
desc: A physical morphing island component that smoothly transitions between a compact indicator, interactive summary, profile card, and social dock with spring physics.

name: evil-eye
title: Evil Eye
desc: A hanging navy amulet disc with concentric sky-blue and white rings that swings with realistic inertia in response to the pointer, painted as a layered SVG and driven by a single spring pipeline.

name: expandable-data-row
title: Expandable Data Row
desc: A polished table component with fluid accordion row unfolding, revealing deep metadata, audit activity feeds, and quick actions, with automatic card restructuring on mobile viewports.

name: expandable-search
title: Expandable Search
desc: A compact search pill that smoothly widens on focus with shortcut hint pills and clear button.

name: faq
title: FAQ
desc: An expandable accordion FAQ component with smooth spring height calculation, single/multi-open modes, category filtering, search, and full ARIA keyboard accessibility.

name: floating-action-dock
title: Floating Action Dock
desc: A floating quick-action toolbar inspired by macOS dock physics with smooth magnification and subtle tooltips.

name: focus-mode
title: Focus Mode
desc: An atmospheric focus-mode interaction that isolates selected cards or sections by smoothly dimming surrounding distractions with zero layout shift, tactile spring scaling, and Escape key dismissal.

name: form
title: Form
desc: A modular, composable form system with accessible inputs, textareas, custom selects, checkboxes, radio groups, switches, and animated validation messages.

name: glass-navbar
title: Glass Navbar
desc: A modern, responsive glassmorphic navbar with smooth spring navigation pills, mobile menu drawer, and keyboard accessibility.

name: glitch-text
title: Glitch Text
desc: A multi-modal cybernetic glitch typography component featuring 5 distinct animation variants (RGB split chromatic aberration, cyberpunk clip-slicing, analog VHS tracking loss, matrix rune scramble decode, and electrical voltage surge).

name: glyph-matrix
title: Glyph Matrix
desc: A high-performance, canvas-driven Matrix digital rain background effect featuring streaming Katakana and numeric glyphs, glowing head highlights, decaying phosphor trails, and interactive cursor disturbances.

name: gooey-menu
title: Gooey Menu
desc: A tactile liquid dropdown menu with organic SVG metaball fusion filter and spring-driven extrusion animation.

name: gravity-particle-burst
title: Gravity Particle Burst
desc: A pointer-triggered canvas particle burst with velocity, gravity, friction, and short-lived physical follow-through.

name: hamburger-menu
title: Hamburger Menu
desc: An iconic three-line menu toggle that transforms smoothly into a symmetrical close symbol.

name: ios-search-bar
title: iOS-style Search Bar
desc: A minimalist search pill that smoothly expands on focus and reveals quick-clear controls with spring animation.

name: interactive-timeline
title: Interactive Timeline
desc: A developer-focused milestone and deployment timeline featuring dynamic progress lines, pulsating status nodes, expandable telemetry cards, and commit hash copy.

name: intro-loader
title: Intro Loader
desc: An Apple-inspired multilingual welcome splash and intro loader that rapidly cycles localized greetings with fluid blur transitions, progress tracking, and accessible skip controls.

name: liquid-ripple-button
title: Liquid Ripple Button
desc: A tactile button whose pointer-origin ripple and subtle wave layer make press feedback feel fluid.

name: liquid-toggle
title: Liquid Toggle
desc: A toggle with a liquid/blob-like transition. The internal shape deforms organically as it travels from off to on — stretching along the travel axis and settling into a natural blob shape rather than simply translating.

name: loader
title: Loader
desc: A minimal, purpose-driven loading indicator with 4 calm, non-anxious motion variants.

name: lock-input
title: LockInput
desc: A text input whose focus state subtly "locks" into place — a focus ring scales in from the center and the border tweens to active, giving the impression that the input snaps closed on itself.

name: login
title: Login
desc: A production-ready authentication card built with the EasyUI form system, featuring password show/hide, remember me, validation states, and social logins.

name: mac-os-folder-cards
title: macOS Folder Cards
desc: An authentic porcelain-white macOS Finder folder icon that unrolls interactive cards with fluid Apple spring physics.

name: magnetic-button
title: Magnetic Button
desc: A responsive button with subtle proximity-based physics that pulls towards the cursor on hover and snaps back on departure.

name: meteors
title: Meteors
desc: A lightweight, highly aesthetic animated meteor shower effect that streams diagonal glowing celestial light beams across cards, badges, hero containers, and call-to-action sections.

name: metric-hud
title: Metric HUD
desc: An interactive developer telemetry card featuring hardware-accelerated SVG sparklines, pointer-scrubbing point inspection, spring-animated time range morphing, and delta indicators.

name: morphing-blob
title: Morphing Blob
desc: An ambient, accessible SVG blob background that continuously morphs with spring physics and subtly follows the cursor for a fluid, interactive visual effect.

name: morphing-button
title: Morphing Button
desc: A layout-stable interactive action button that smoothly transitions between Idle, Loading, Success, and Error states without jarring jumps or dimension shifts.

name: morphing-dialog
title: Morphing Dialog
desc: An expandable card trigger that fluidly morphs into a centered dialog without jarring popup animations.

name: morphing-icon
title: Morphing Icon
desc: An animated micro-interaction wrapper that smoothly morphs between two icon states with coordinated rotation, scale, and cross-fade transitions.

name: morphing-shape-loader
title: Morphing Shape Loader
desc: A loading indicator that continuously morphs between configurable SVG shapes via real path interpolation. The transition is a genuine geometric morph — never a fade out / in.

name: neon-edge-button
title: Neon Edge Button
desc: A button with a restrained light source travelling around the border while the label remains primary.

name: nimbu-mirchi
title: Nimbu Mirchi
desc: A hanging lemon-and-green-chilli charm that swings with realistic inertia in response to the pointer, built from layered physical springs rather than a single rigid illustration.

name: not-found
title: Not Found
desc: A minimal, production-ready 404 / route error component featuring floating spring-physics proximity displacement on individual glyphs, clear typography hierarchy, and accessible recovery actions.

name: notification-bell
title: Notification Bell
desc: An interactive notification trigger with animated badge counter, arrival shake feedback, and dropdown panel.

name: notification-stack
title: Notification Stack
desc: A stacked notification card system with physical spring stacking elevation, swipe-to-dismiss drag, and simulation triggers.

name: orbital-loading-ring
title: Orbital Loading Ring
desc: A lightweight loading indicator with layered rings and orbiting particles that communicate active processing.

name: origin-dropdown
title: OriginDropdown
desc: A dropdown with origin-aware expansion — the menu materializes from the chosen side with a slight scale and an inward translation, so its perceived origin is the trigger edge closest to the menu.

name: otp-input
title: OTP Input
desc: An accessible one-time-passcode input made of auto-advancing digit boxes, each with a spring-driven pop animation on entry, built with Framer Motion and Tailwind CSS.

name: particle-delete
title: Particle Delete
desc: Premium physics-driven particle dissolution delete animation that rasterizes components into thousands of authentic tiny pixels and disperses them smoothly before state removal.

name: payment-receipt-printer
title: Payment Receipt Printer
desc: An animated payment and order receipt printer component for React featuring realistic thermal paper extrusion, chassis micro-vibration, customizable receipt itemization, and replay controls.

name: payment-status
title: Payment Status
desc: A calm, Apple-grade payment confirmation card with animated SVG path checkmark drawing, staged verification lifecycle transitions, receipt inspection, and failure recovery.

name: peek-card
title: Peek Card
desc: An origin-anchored contextual preview popover that emerges directly from target triggers on hover or tap with smart collision edge detection and rich metadata summaries.

name: pill-navigation
title: Pill Navigation
desc: A restrained segmented navigation control with shared pill layout morphing and nested submenu dropdown support.

name: press-button
title: PressButton
desc: A button that compresses slightly on press and settles with a tiny natural overshoot for a tactile, physical feel.

name: pricing
title: Pricing
desc: A minimal two-tier pricing component for EasyUI. Native to the existing design system, fully theme-aware, with a quiet Free tier and a slightly more attractive Pro tier — without resorting to SaaS marketing tropes.

name: profile-card
title: Profile Card
desc: A premium dark social profile card with a painted blue cover-art panel, action row, and a detail panel with avatar, verified name, bio, follower stats, and outbound website link.

name: pull-to-refresh
title: Pull to Refresh
desc: A physical pull-to-refresh component and container featuring realistic elastic resistance curves, smooth cubic bezier line chart visualization with interactive point scrubbing, high/low metrics, and seamless light & dark mode compatibility.

name: rainbow-button
title: Rainbow Button
desc: A vibrant button featuring an animated chromatic rainbow gradient border, dynamic 3D surface reflections, and an ambient blurred rainbow underglow.

name: recovery-ledger
title: Recovery Ledger
desc: An archival audit timeline and state recovery ledger with chronological snapshot markers, diff inspection, and one-click rollback triggers.

name: reveal-card
title: Reveal Card
desc: A high-definition product card with smooth cursor-driven 3D perspective rotation, dynamic glare, and revealed content.

name: rocket-party-popper
title: Rocket Party Popper
desc: An interactive black rocket launch that blasts into a colorful party popper confetti shower to reveal celebratory milestones.

name: scroll-progress-nav
title: Scroll Progress Navigation
desc: A floating table-of-contents navigation pill that tracks scroll depth, dynamically morphs between resting and floating states, highlights active sections, and enables smooth scrolling.

name: scrollvelocitytext
title: Scroll Velocity Text
desc: A direction-aware kinetic typography component that smoothly expands letter-spacing and scale on downward scroll, and winds back on upward scroll, with zero per-frame React re-renders.

name: selection-basket
title: Selection Basket
desc: A floating bulk-action toolbar that smoothly rises from the bottom of the screen when multiple dataset items are selected, supporting batch operations, horizontal scrolling, and clear triggers.

name: settle-modal
title: SettleModal
desc: A modal whose content has a tiny scale/settle instead of a generic fade. The panel scales 0.94 -> 1.02 -> 1.0 with a small y travel, then the inner content layers its own gentle settle on top.

name: shooting-stars
title: Shooting Stars
desc: A high-performance deep-space cosmos background featuring multi-depth twinkling celestial stars, glowing atmospheric nebula clouds, and cinematic shooting stars with luminous head flares, tapered fading trails, ember stardust, and click-to-summon interactivity.

name: sign-up
title: Sign Up
desc: A comprehensive registration card with live password strength metrics, password confirmation matching, terms validation, and social onboarding.

name: slide-pagination
title: SlidePagination
desc: A pagination control where the active indicator slides between pages rather than instantly switching. The active background uses shared layoutId so the indicator visibly travels from one item to the next.

name: small-floating-dock
title: Small Floating Dock
desc: A minimal, gesture-responsive floating dock for quick access to 3-5 primary actions.

name: smart-comparison
title: Smart Comparison
desc: An interactive feature matrix and SaaS tier comparison component featuring live difference filtering, collapsible specification categories, search indexing, and mobile card toggle.

name: smooth-accordion
title: Smooth Accordion
desc: An accordion component with physics height transition, rotating chevron indicators, and accessible keyboard toggles.

name: sparkles-core
title: Sparkles Core
desc: A high-performance, zero-dependency particle sparkle canvas with multi-shape geometry (circles, radiant diamond stars, cross starlets), organic twinkling, interactive cursor repulsion/attraction, click particle bursts, and fluid SSR safety.

name: speed-warp
title: Speed Warp
desc: A 3D perspective canvas starfield simulation that projects relativistic light streaks toward the viewer, creating an intense hyperspace or warp drive velocity effect.

name: split-button
title: Split Button
desc: A primary action fused with a chevron trigger that reveals related actions in a spring-timed dropdown, sharing a single pill silhouette.

name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
desc: A dark elevated surface that illuminates border and inner surfaces dynamically based on mouse pointer coordinates.

name: spotlight-search
title: Spotlight Search
desc: A global command palette and search overlay triggered by ⌘K featuring real-time fuzzy filtering, moving active highlight springs, kbd shortcuts, and full keyboard navigation.

name: spring-select
title: SpringSelect
desc: A select dropdown whose menu follows the trigger with a tiny spring. The chevron rotates a hair past 180° before settling, and the panel slides down with a subtle overshoot.

name: stack-unfold-panel
title: Stack Unfold Panel
desc: A vertically stacked card deck that unfolds progressively with spring physics, shifting adjacent panels with zero layout jank.

name: stacked-cards
title: Stacked Cards
desc: A responsive, scroll-driven stacking cards component built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Cards start aligned in a column and stack gracefully on scroll without hijacking page scrolling.

name: sticky-pages
title: Sticky Pages
desc: A pure static full-page sticky stacking scroll component where pages slide up and stack cleanly one over another without any tilting or distortion, before releasing smoothly into natural page scrolling.

name: story-card
title: Story Cards
desc: A responsive, accessible story cards carousel for React applications built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.

name: stretch-switch
title: StretchSwitch
desc: A toggle switch whose thumb stretches slightly while dragging or pressing, then snaps naturally to its destination via a snappy spring.

name: text-scramble-decoder
title: Text Scramble Decoder
desc: A controlled text reveal that resolves scrambled glyphs into readable copy without changing the text semantics.

name: thinking-orb
title: Thinking Orb
desc: Minimalist monochrome spherical particle vortex with orbital physics, pure black-and-white luminous styling, and 9 cognitive state deformations.

name: torque-dial
title: Torque Dial
desc: A rotational control dial with realistic physical angular momentum, velocity tracking, and exponential friction deceleration.

name: typewriter-button
title: Typewriter Button
desc: An interactive button that reveals its label character-by-character with optional synthesized mechanical audio feedback.

name: undo-toast
title: Undo Toast
desc: An advanced undo notification toast featuring an interactive progress countdown, pause-on-hover mechanics, action reversal animation, and versatile position anchoring.

name: unfold-accordion
title: UnfoldAccordion
desc: An accordion whose content unfolds with the chevron and spacing moving together. The chevron rotates 180° while the content height expands and the inner content slides up to close the gap, producing a single, fluid motion.

name: velocity-toast
title: VelocityToast
desc: A toast that enters with velocity and settles, with a progress indicator that responds naturally — pauses on hover, resumes with no jump, and eases slightly in the final 10% so dismissal feels intentional.

name: wallet-card
title: Wallet Card
desc: A premium dark wallet card with a blue radial-gradient surface, live balance display, iOS-style toggle, and a primary action button. The card surface responds to the pointer with a soft cyan shine driven entirely by MotionValues.

name: 3d-button
title: Tactile 3D
desc: Universal 3D button with tactile keycap shadows — pass any children (label, icon + label). Variants: solid, soft, muted. Sizes: sm, md, lg, icon. Press sinks the key in.

name: 3d-icon-button
title: Tactile 3D Icon
desc: Square 3D icon button — pass any icon as children and a required label for accessibility. Same solid / soft / muted materials as ThreeDButton.

name: soft-ui-button
title: Neumorphic Soft UI
desc: Universal soft-UI / neumorphic button — even light and dark shadows. Pass any children. Press flips to an inset look.

name: inset-button
title: Recessed Inset
desc: Recessed inset button — looks pressed into the surface. Light or dark variant. Pass any children.

name: soft-pill-button
title: Floating Pill
desc: Floating rounded pill with a soft drop shadow — light or dark. Pass any children. Nudges down slightly on press.

name: depth-outline-button
title: Depth Outline
desc: Premium outline button with layered float depth, a soft top lip, and a press-in sink — secondary CTA that still feels tactile. Pass any children.

name: sheen-pill-button
title: Sheen Pill
desc: Frosted pill with layered shade veil, light band, and rim wire — hover brightens the sheen and clears the fill. Pass width, height, and highlight to tune the frame.

name: prism-depth-button
title: Prism Depth
desc: Dark depth button with a cyan edge flare, rim glow, and layered core veil — pass any label as children.

name: dimple-switch
title: Dimple Switch
desc: Tactile switch with a dimpled knob, metallic track, and amber on-state fill. Hidden checkbox drives the slide — controlled or uncontrolled.

name: cinder-latch-button
title: Cinder Latch
desc: Charcoal latch button with a warm ember under-glow, center groove, and face sheen — built for secure-action CTAs.

name: slate-chip-switch
title: Slate Chip Switch
desc: Smooth pill chip switch with a white thumb and sky on-state fill — a cleaner alternative to textured toggles.

name: linen-tab-button
title: Linen Tab
desc: Woven linen tab with dashed stitch borders and a soft fold sheen — warm, editorial, and understated.

name: slide-to-confirm-button
title: Slide to Confirm
desc: Drag the knob across the track to commit an action — snaps back if you release early, locks green when confirmed. Great for irreversible or high-intent actions.

name: hold-to-delete-button
title: Hold to Delete
desc: Press and hold as a fill sweeps across; release early to cancel, hold to the end to delete. Prevents accidental destructive taps.

name: add-to-cart-button
title: Add to Cart
desc: Raised 3D add-to-cart key that sinks in while adding, with gentle label crossfades, then pops back up in a solid emerald added state before resetting.

name: like-button
title: Like Toggle
desc: Heart toggle that pops and scatters particles on the way up, with a live count. Pill fills rose when active — no glow, no gradient.

name: copy-button
title: Copy to Clipboard
desc: Copies text to the clipboard and cross-fades the copy icon into a check with a Copied label. Monospace value, resets on its own.

name: quantity-stepper-button
title: Quantity Stepper
desc: Inline minus / count / plus control for carts and forms. Clamps between min and max, disables at the edges.

name: download-button
title: Download with States
desc: Raised 3D download key that sinks while downloading — arrow morphs to spinner to check — then pops back up as a solid emerald done state.

name: follow-button
title: Follow Toggle
desc: Social follow toggle — dark Follow pill becomes a quiet Following state with a user-check icon. Tap again to unfollow.

name: bookmark-save-button
title: Bookmark Save
desc: Save for later — bookmark icon fills amber and label swaps to Saved. Square-ish control for articles and products.

name: segmented-toggle-button
title: Segmented Control
desc: iOS segmented control — sliding white pill between Day, Week, and Month. Pass your own options array for view modes or filters.

name: analog-clock-roman
title: Analog Clock — Roman
desc: A live analog clock dressed in roman numerals — classic dial, real moving hands. Swap the variant prop to match the mood of your layout.

name: analog-clock-minimal
title: Analog Clock — Minimal
desc: Ticks and hands on a quiet face, nothing else. When you want the time to sit in the background without shouting over your UI.

name: analog-clock-numeric
title: Analog Clock — Numeric
desc: Arabic numerals and a live second hand on a clean analog dial. Readable from across the room, still far from a default system clock.

name: wifi-toggle
title: wifi-toggle
desc: The toggle you'd expect on an iPhone — network name, on/off switch, that familiar iOS weight. Drop it into any control panel or settings screen.

name: voice-assistant
title: voice-assistant
desc: Animated equalizer bars and a mic button that flip between idle and listening. Builds the voice-AI moment without building the whole assistant.

name: ios-earbuds
title: ios-earbuds
desc: AirPods-style widget showing device name and connection status. Small, familiar, and perfect beside other iOS-style controls.

name: recorder-face
title: recorder-face
desc: A quirky record button with a mascot face, circular dial, and live timer. Tap to start and pause — feels like a tiny dedicated recorder app.

name: battery-face
title: battery-face
desc: Battery level as a character — arc ring, percentage, hours left, and a face that actually looks sad when you're running low.

name: compass
title: compass
desc: A compass dial with labeled directions and a needle that follows device tilt. Pass a heading prop or let the browser handle orientation.

name: bluetooth-face
title: bluetooth-face
desc: A teal mascot face that reacts when Bluetooth connects or drops. Toggle on/off with an expression change — playful, but still reads as a real status widget.

name: torch-face
title: torch-face
desc: Yellow flashlight toggle with a face that lights up when the torch is on. Small detail, but the kind people notice on a control sheet.

name: dnd-face
title: dnd-face
desc: Focus mode as a purple moon mascot — tap to toggle DND and watch the expression shift. Makes a utilitarian setting feel a little human.

name: ios-digital-clock
title: ios-digital-clock
desc: Live HH:MM in an iOS squircle with subtle tick marks around the edge. The kind of clock tile you'd find on a lock screen.

name: ios-calender
title: ios-calender
desc: Today's date in the classic iOS calendar tile — red weekday, big day number, month underneath. Updates live, no refresh needed.

name: stopwatch
title: stopwatch
desc: Millisecond-precision stopwatch with reset, play-pause, and stop in a compact white widget. Running state shown with a small indicator dot.

name: ios-map-location
title: ios-map-location
desc: Map pin widget with your city name — simple location card in the iOS family. Good for travel apps, weather screens, or profile headers.

name: focus-breath
title: focus-breath
desc: A breathing guide that pulses between inhale and exhale every four seconds. One tap to start — useful in wellness or focus flows.

name: blob-profile
title: blob-profile
desc: Profile card with an organic blob-shaped photo frame, name, verified check, and handle. Stands out from every circular-avatar layout on the web.

name: editorial-staff-profile
title: editorial-staff-profile
desc: Numbered editorial roster row with serif name, uppercase role, and a square photo. Built for about pages and team indexes.

name: user-profile
title: user-profile
desc: Author byline on warm editorial paper — square portrait, serif name, and text links. Built for personal sites and portfolio sidebars.

name: contact-profile
title: contact-profile
desc: Museum placard contact directory — mono labels, serif name, and typographic rows without icon clutter.

name: team-member-profile-grid
title: team-member-profile-grid

title: mac-dock

name: app-dock
title: app-dock
desc: Bottom app launcher dock matching MacDock shell, spacing, and hover lift — with active state and optional labels.

name: editor-tool-dock
title: editor-tool-dock
desc: Vertical editor tool dock using MacDock tile size, padding, and ease-smooth hover scale.

name: presence-dock
title: presence-dock
desc: Collaborator presence dock with MacDock-sized avatar tiles and expandable member list.

name: spotlight-bar
title: spotlight-bar
desc: Spotlight-style command search in the frosted dock shell — keyboard nav and suggestions.

name: step-count
title: step-count
desc: Editorial step stat — light wide card, large number, goal in a quiet footer row. No progress bars or icons.

name: pomodoro
title: pomodoro
desc: Dark pomodoro timer — thin ring, split monospace time, tap to start or pause. Polished to match the DND card size and proportions.

name: hydration
title: hydration
desc: Tall bottle card — count at the top, water level rises inside a simple bottle outline. Tap to log a glass.

name: sleep-score
title: sleep-score
desc: Sleep score in the DND face layout — sleeping mascot at the bottom, score and quality above, duration tucked below.

name: heart-rate
title: heart-rate
desc: Heart rate in the DND face layout — mascot at the bottom, BPM above the dial, soft pulse on the ring.

name: daily-activity-calendar
title: daily-activity-calendar
desc: Month grid for the current month — today is highlighted in orange, with a short emerald streak on prior days. Pass activeDays or highlightDay to override.

name: month-picker-calendar
title: month-picker-calendar
desc: Full month picker with prev/next navigation — tap any day to select it, today gets a quiet ring.

name: week-strip-calendar
title: week-strip-calendar
desc: Horizontal week strip for booking and scheduling apps — arrow through weeks, tap a day to select.

name: date-range-picker
title: date-range-picker
desc: Travel-style date range picker — first tap sets check-in, second sets check-out, days between fill in.

name: team-members-table
title: team-members-table
desc: Team members with profile photos, email, role, and status. Uses /profile-picture.png and /woman.png avatars.

name: orders-table
title: orders-table
desc: E-commerce orders table — sort by date, total, or status. The standard admin dashboard orders view.

name: users-select-table
title: users-select-table
desc: Bulk-select users table with header checkbox and live selection count. Clean white admin pattern for permissions or exports.

name: recent-transactions-table
title: recent-transactions-table
desc: Stripe-style transaction list with positive and negative amounts and simple pagination.

name: tasks-table
title: tasks-table
desc: Project tasks with checkboxes, assignee avatars, and due dates. Tap to mark complete.

name: customers-table
title: customers-table
desc: SaaS customer list with plan, last active, and MRR. Common billing dashboard table.

name: resource-links-panel

title: event-countdown-card

name: booking-slot-calendar
title: booking-slot-calendar

name: audio-recorder
title: audio-recorder
desc: Dark recording card with title, date, animated red waveform, and elapsed time. Play and pause feel like a native voice memo app.

name: flight-arrival
title: flight-arrival
desc: Countdown to landing with departure and arrival airports and a plane moving along a progress bar. Built for travel dashboards and trip widgets.

name: minimal-agenda
title: minimal-agenda
desc: Today's tasks with times — tap a row to mark it done with a strikethrough and checkmark. Clean enough for a daily planner sidebar.

name: ride-pickup

name: electric-scooter
title: electric-scooter
desc: Ride summary with scooter photo, distance, average speed, and duration. Leaf icon included — built for micro-mobility or fitness stats.

title: Apple Macbook
desc: MacBook Pro frame wrapping your screenshot — black lid and bezel with a gray outer frame and base. Pass variant="titanium" for a titanium outer frame and base.

name: apple-watch
title: Apple Watch
desc: Apple Watch frame with sport band and a rounded display slot for your UI. Pass variant for black, silver, titanium, starlight, blue, gold, or rose finishes.

name: browser
title: Apple Browser
desc: Desktop browser chrome with traffic lights and a URL bar framing your website screenshot. Pass theme for light, dark, or transparent chrome.

name: ipod
title: Apple iPod
desc: Classic iPod frame with a screen slot and click wheel — silver, black, white, pink, blue, green, or red finishes. Drop any UI into the screen area.

name: polaroid-image
